title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
summary: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
summary: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
summary: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

title: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
summary: The funding, backing a U.S.-incorporated issuer codenamed “Project Faro,” covers five years of operations as traditional lenders move to challenge crypto-native giants Tether and Circle.

title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
summary: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
summary: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

summary: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

summary: An aide said Trump family crypto businesses should "preserve their documents" as Warren prepares to take over the Senate Banking Committee.

title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
summary: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report

summary: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

title: Strategy Buys $82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $188M of STRC

title: Coinbase Joins Circle, Ripple With Final OCC Approval for Federal Trust Bank Charter
